facts.text: Carrie should go to the prom. Tommy, take her and get her some punch and cake.
facts.why: Sue never says this. In the film she asks Tommy to invite Carrie to the prom out of guilt, but this wording is made up. It is printed in quote marks as her words.
facts.fix: Tommy, take Carrie to the prom. Get her some punch and cake, and be kind.

facts.text: Tommy's toast to the new prom king and queen.
facts.why: The plot has Tommy and Carrie crowned prom king and queen, then the blood. No toast shows in the transcript or Wikipedia.
